artifact.name: configurable-tree-traversal
artifact.identityNote: Tree hash covers artifactRoot files in listed order; checkoutCommit describes the enclosing checkout, not proof that dist was built from it. Local version may equal a published version.

policy.caseOrder: shape, empty/prefix seed, sync/async, eager/lazy; one warmup then samples; sequential
policy.completedWorkSeeds: empty or first floor(V/2) IDs; prerequisite-closed
policy.batchRanking: fixture ID order, outside measured regions
policy.asyncVisitor: await Promise.resolve() then DEFER_READY; callback scheduling overhead, no external I/O
policy.frontierScope: pre-run summaries and open lazy boundaries are partial-discovery; full-fixture Kahn retains all prerequisite edges and projects ready IDs onto discovered IDs. Global readiness claims only at discovery.complete boundaries; the flat synthetic catalog resolves all V declarations before its first quiescent frontier
policy.memory: A bounded number of snapshots per sample, replaced each tick; no accumulated graph history, heap deltas or forced GC. Raw ID facts bounded by CLI counts.
policy.tickStatistics: Each tick aggregates only samples reaching that tick; sampleCount is explicit.

timingNotes.fixtureConstructionMs: IDs/prerequisite arrays only, one shared fixture per shape outside samples; seed construction excluded
timingNotes.runnerConstructionMs: adapter index, copied completed seeds, constructor, visitor registration and makeRunner
timingNotes.initialRunMs: run entry to quiescence, includes discovery, validation and deferred callback scheduling; async awaits run completion
timingNotes.settlementBatchMs: settle calls plus boolean result collection; excludes rank, generation lookup, accepted-fact updates and assertions; no run included
timingNotes.settlementPerAcceptedMs: settlementBatchMs / actual accepted count; overlaps settlementBatchMs
timingNotes.resumedRunMs: run entry to quiescence after settlements; excludes settlement calls and summaries
timingNotes.reconstructionSetupMs: fresh adapter/runner construction from exactly the retained accepted completion facts; includes seed copy
timingNotes.reconstructionRunMs: fresh run to quiescence including full rediscovery, validation and remaining callbacks
timingNotes.reconstructionTotalMs: sum of reconstructionSetupMs and reconstructionRunMs; overlaps both, excludes summaries/assertions and the timer gap
timingNotes.summaryBatchMs: repeated retained summary() plus consuming vertices.size, including allocation/possible GC; assertions excluded; sampled initially and after each tick
timingNotes.reconstructionSummaryBatchMs: same summary loop for reconstructed runner; separate from reconstructionTotalMs
